integrity: The infinite result is proved by identifying the primitive integer kernel of the truncated Pascal moment matrix and intersecting that one-dimensional lattice with the nonnegative orthant. Independent finite checks use both run-vector fibres and direct subsequence-count dynamic programming.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the truncation ending at a^(m-1)b for binary words with known length and known m=|w|_a. It does not classify deeper truncations, nonbinary alphabets, or globally minimal measurement sets.
title: Exact ambiguity one coefficient short of right-bounded-block reconstruction
